output_commit_note: Every production output remains byte-identical to the accepted starting commit; the commit containing this report changes evidence and plans only.

resolution.initial_assertion: Whole-baseline comparison found only the two planning documents updated by 6A; their changes were inspected and accepted at the required starting commit.

snapshot_method.membership: git ls-files -z plus recursive files throughout the physical development root, including ignored non-cache files and nested worktrees; tracked paths retained inside excluded directories.
snapshot_method.measurements: st_mtime_ns, raw byte length, SHA-256, raw Git blob SHA-1 and filtered Git blob identity. Raw hashes are re-read for every snapshot; unchanged primary-checkout raw hashes reuse the initial filtered identity after rechecking all .gitattributes hashes. Changed files use git hash-object --stdin-paths. No file is normalized or rewritten for comparison.
snapshot_method.nested_qualification: Physical-root snapshots include separate Git worktrees. Their raw hashes and mtimes are observations, not writes attributed to the production command. Parent-checkout filtered identities from the initial/parse captures are not accepted as nested-worktree identities: concurrent editing could occur between raw and filtered reads. Later captures explicitly leave nested filtered identities null; raw Git identities remain recorded.
snapshot_method.permanent_evidence: Exact input/output memberships are included per command. Every actual changed file has before/after states; conditional untouched outputs have both states. Snapshot digests and unchanged-primary-complement digests cover the complete scope. Full snapshots and log files remain convenience copies in the ignored scratch directory; command logs are also embedded here.
snapshot_method.snapshot_digest_serialization: SHA-256 of json.dumps(states, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=True).encode('utf-8').
